    def read_config(filename):
        raw=json.loads(Path(filename).read_text())
        base=load_settings(raw.pop('base_config',str(ROOT/'configs/rl-retail.json')))
        extra={key:value for key,value in raw.items() if key in asdict(base)}
        opsd={key:value for key,value in raw.items() if key not in asdict(base)}
        return load_settings(raw.get('base_config',str(ROOT/'configs/rl-retail.json')),extra),opsd
    
    
    def validate_opsd_config(cfg,opsd):
        defaults={'collection_rollouts_per_task':4,'max_candidates':48,'hint_temperature':0.0,
            'hint_max_tokens':384,'recovery_max_actions':12,'recovery_weight':1.0,
            'preservation_weight':0.25,'epochs_per_round':1,'output_dir':'outputs/opsd-retail'}
        unknown=set(opsd)-set(defaults)
        if unknown: raise ValueError('Unknown OPSD settings: '+', '.join(sorted(unknown)))
        defaults.update(opsd)
        for key in ('collection_rollouts_per_task','max_candidates','hint_max_tokens','recovery_max_actions','epochs_per_round'):
            if type(defaults[key]) is not int or defaults[key]<1: raise ValueError(key+' must be a positive integer')
        for key in ('hint_temperature','recovery_weight','preservation_weight'):
            if type(defaults[key]) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(defaults[key]) or defaults[key]<0: raise ValueError(key+' must be nonnegative')
        if defaults['hint_temperature']>2: raise ValueError('hint_temperature must be <= 2')
        if defaults['recovery_weight']+defaults['preservation_weight']<=0: raise ValueError('At least one loss weight must be positive')
        defaults['output_dir']=str(path(defaults['output_dir']))
        return defaults
    
    
    def tool_error(message):
        if message.get('role')!='tool': return False
        if message.get('error') is True or message.get('name')=='__runtime__': return True
        content=message.get('content')
        if isinstance(content,str):
            try: content=json.loads(content)
            except (TypeError,ValueError): return False
        if isinstance(content,dict):
            body=content.get('content',content)
            if isinstance(body,dict):
                return bool(body.get('error')) or str(body.get('status','')).lower() in {'error','failed','failure'} or body.get('success') is False
        return False
    
    
    def find_candidates(episode,source_file):
        actions=episode.get('actions') or [];messages=episode.get('messages') or [];found=[]
        for index,action in enumerate(actions[:-1]):
            start=int(action['raw_message_count'])+1
            end=int(actions[index+1]['raw_message_count'])
            observations=messages[start:end]
            errors=[(start+offset,m) for offset,m in enumerate(observations) if tool_error(m)]
            if not errors: continue
            error_index,error_message=errors[0]
            if not any(m.get('role') in ('tool','user') for m in observations): continue
            found.append(dict(candidate_id=f"{episode['episode_id']}:after-turn-{action['turn']}",
                source_file=str(source_file),episode_id=episode['episode_id'],task_id=str(episode['task_id']),
                seed=episode['seed'],baseline_reward=episode.get('reward'),failure_turn=action['turn'],
                recovery_turn=actions[index+1]['turn'],failure_action=action.get('text',''),
                error_message=copy.deepcopy(error_message),error_message_index=error_index,
                recovery_messages=copy.deepcopy(messages[:end]),full_messages=copy.deepcopy(messages),
                policy_version=episode.get('policy_version'),classification='explicit_tool_error',
                replay_verified=False,hint=None,hinted_reward=None,hint_validation_passed=False))
        return found
    
    
    def _canonical(messages):
        keep=('role','content','name','error','tool_call_id','tool_calls')
        return [{k:m[k] for k in keep if k in m and m[k] is not None} for m in messages]
    
    
    def create_runtime(policy,cfg,seed):
        from openai import OpenAI
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer
        from tau2_grpo.rl_context import ContextController,FrozenSummarizer
        from tau2_grpo.rl_tau2 import ExternalChat,RetailEnvironment
        ext_tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg.external_tokenizer,revision=cfg.external_revision)
        client=OpenAI(base_url=cfg.user_base_url,api_key='local',timeout=180,max_retries=0)
        external=ExternalChat(client,ext_tokenizer,cfg,[])
        summarizer=FrozenSummarizer(client,cfg.user_model,ext_tokenizer,cfg.external_context_limit,cfg.summary_max_tokens)
        controller=ContextController(policy.tokenizer,summarizer,cfg.context_limit,cfg.response_tokens,cfg.prompt_budget)
        env=RetailEnvironment(seed=seed,task_id='',cfg=cfg,external=external)
        return client,controller,env
    
    
    def replay_to_recovery(policy,cfg,candidate):
        """Reconstruct the state and reject any prompt/observation replay mismatch."""
        from tau2_grpo.rl_tau2 import RetailEnvironment
        client,controller,env=create_runtime(policy,cfg,int(candidate['seed']))
        try:
            env.task_id=str(candidate['task_id']);raw=env.reset()
            episode=json.loads(Path(candidate['source_file']).read_text())
            actions=episode['actions'];recovery_turn=int(candidate['recovery_turn'])
            if not 0<recovery_turn<len(actions): raise ValueError('Recovery point lacks a following recorded action')
            for index,action in enumerate(actions[:recovery_turn]):
                prepared=controller.prepare(raw,int(candidate['seed'])+int(action['turn']))
                if prepared['prompt_ids']!=action['prompt_ids']:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"prompt_replay_mismatch_at_turn_{action['turn']}")
                raw_count=int(action['raw_message_count'])
                assistant=episode['messages'][raw_count]
                if assistant.get('role')!='assistant' or assistant.get('content')!=action.get('text'):
                    raise RuntimeError('saved assistant turn does not align with action record')
                raw.append(copy.deepcopy(assistant))
                incoming,done,_call=env.step(action['text'])
                expected_end=int(actions[index+1]['raw_message_count'])
                expected=episode['messages'][raw_count+1:expected_end]
                if _canonical(incoming)!=_canonical(expected):
                    raise RuntimeError(f"environment_replay_mismatch_after_turn_{action['turn']}")
                raw.extend(incoming)
                if done: raise RuntimeError('environment became terminal before recovery point')
            recovery_action=actions[recovery_turn]
            prepared=controller.prepare(raw,int(candidate['seed'])+recovery_turn)
            if prepared['prompt_ids']!=recovery_action['prompt_ids']:
                raise RuntimeError(f"recovery_prompt_mismatch_at_turn_{recovery_turn}")
            return client,controller,env,raw,prepared
        except Exception:
            try: env.close()
            finally: client.close()
            raise
    
    
    def _token_ids(tokenizer,messages):
        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages,tokenize=True,return_dict=False,
            add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)
    
    
    def diagnostic_messages(candidate,tokenizer,cfg):
        from tau2_grpo.rl_context import student_messages
        system=(ROOT/'templates/retail_opsd_diagnoser.txt').read_text()
        prefix=student_messages(candidate['recovery_messages'])
        full=student_messages(candidate['full_messages'])
        payload={'task_id':candidate['task_id'],'failure_turn':candidate['failure_turn'],
            'recovery_state':prefix,'completed_student_trajectory_for_hindsight':full,
            'observed_tool_error':candidate['error_message'],
            'final_tau2_reward':candidate.get('baseline_reward'),
            'instruction':'Diagnose the observed error after the rollout has ended. Return a short safe next-turn hint grounded only in recovery_state.'}
        messages=[{'role':'system','content':system},{'role':'user','content':json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))}]
        if len(_token_ids(tokenizer,messages))+cfg.hint_max_tokens>cfg.external_context_limit:
            # Preserve the entire causal prefix and shrink only hindsight context.
            payload['completed_student_trajectory_for_hindsight']=full[:2]+full[-12:]
            payload['hindsight_excerpted']=True
            messages[1]['content']=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
        if len(_token_ids(tokenizer,messages))+cfg.hint_max_tokens>cfg.external_context_limit:
            raise ValueError('Hint diagnosis input exceeds teacher context even after excerpting hindsight')
        return messages
    
    
    def validate_annotation(raw):
        try: item=json.loads(raw)
        except (TypeError,ValueError) as error: raise ValueError('diagnosis is not JSON') from error
        keys={'diagnosis','confidence','recoverability','hint'}
        if not isinstance(item,dict) or set(item)!=keys: raise ValueError('diagnosis schema must contain exactly '+str(sorted(keys)))
        if item['confidence'] not in ('high','medium','low'): raise ValueError('invalid confidence')
        if item['recoverability'] not in ('recoverable','uncertain','not_recoverable'): raise ValueError('invalid recoverability')
        for name,lo,hi in (('diagnosis',4,48),('hint',4,40)):
            value=item[name]
            if not isinstance(value,str) or not lo<=len(value.split())<=hi: raise ValueError(name+' has invalid length')
            if re.search(r'<tool_call>|```|\b(?:ignore|override) (?:the )?(?:system|policy)\b',value,re.I): raise ValueError(name+' contains unsafe control text')
        if re.search(r'\b(?:the answer is|the correct value is|use this exact value)\b',item['hint'],re.I):
            raise ValueError('hint appears to disclose a target value')
        return item
    
    
    def generate_hints(run,cfg,opsd):
        from openai import OpenAI
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer
        run=Path(run);candidates=[]
        for file in sorted((run/'collection').glob('episode-*.json')):
            episode=json.loads(file.read_text());candidates.extend(find_candidates(episode,file))
        candidates=candidates[:opsd['max_candidates']]
        tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg.external_tokenizer,revision=cfg.external_revision)
        client=OpenAI(base_url=cfg.user_base_url,api_key='local',timeout=180,max_retries=0)
        saved=[]
        try:
            for candidate in candidates:
                messages=diagnostic_messages(candidate,tokenizer,opsd)
                response=client.chat.completions.create(model=cfg.user_model,messages=messages,
                    temperature=opsd['hint_temperature'],max_tokens=opsd['hint_max_tokens'],
                    response_format={'type':'json_object'},
                    extra_body={'chat_template_kwargs':{'enable_thinking':False}})
                if response.choices[0].finish_reason=='length': raise RuntimeError('Hint diagnosis was truncated')
                raw=response.choices[0].message.content or ''
                candidate['diagnosis_annotation']=validate_annotation(raw)
                candidate['diagnosis_raw']=raw
                candidate['diagnosis_model']=cfg.user_model
                candidate['diagnosis_messages']=messages
                candidate['hindsight_excerpted']=bool(json.loads(messages[1]['content']).get('hindsight_excerpted'))
                candidate['recovery_messages']=candidate['recovery_messages']
                saved.append(candidate)
                atomic_json(run/'candidates.json',saved)
                print(json.dumps({'candidate_id':candidate['candidate_id'],'task_id':candidate['task_id'],
                    'failure_turn':candidate['failure_turn'],'recoverability':candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['recoverability'],
                    'hint':candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['hint']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        finally: client.close()
        (run/'hints.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in saved))
        return saved
    
    
    def hinted_raw_messages(raw,hint):
        """Append hint to model-facing context only; never modify Tau2 state/history."""
        return hint
    
    
    def rollout_from_recovery(policy,cfg,candidate,with_hint=False,max_actions=12):
        hint=candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['hint'] if with_hint else None
        client,controller,env,raw,prepared=replay_to_recovery(policy,cfg,candidate)
        actions=[];done=False;total_tokens=0;error=None;simulation=None;reward=None
        try:
            for offset in range(max_actions):
                guidance=hint if offset==0 else None
                prepared=controller.prepare(raw,int(candidate['seed'])+int(candidate['recovery_turn'])+offset,
                    guidance=guidance)
                result=policy.generate(prepared,cfg.response_tokens,
                    int(candidate['seed'])+int(candidate['recovery_turn'])+offset)
                if not result['completion_ids'] or not result['ended_with_eos']:
                    raise RuntimeError('recovery_action_truncated_or_empty')
                action=dict(**prepared,**result,turn=int(candidate['recovery_turn'])+offset,
                    policy_version=policy.version,raw_message_count=len(raw),temperature=cfg.temperature)
                actions.append(action);total_tokens+=len(result['completion_ids'])
                raw.append({'role':'assistant','content':result['text']})
                incoming,done,_call=env.step(result['text']);raw.extend(incoming)
                if done: break
            reward,simulation=env.finish()
            return dict(complete=True,reward=reward,simulation=simulation,messages=raw,actions=actions,
                total_tokens=total_tokens,used_hint=with_hint,stop_reason='terminal' if done else 'recovery_action_budget')
        except Exception as exc:
            error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
            return dict(complete=False,reward=None,error=error,messages=raw,actions=actions,
                total_tokens=total_tokens,used_hint=with_hint)
        finally:
            try: env.close()
            finally: client.close()
    
    
    def validate_candidates(policy,cfg,run,candidates,opsd):
        output=[]
        for i,candidate in enumerate(candidates):
            ann=candidate.get('diagnosis_annotation') or {}
            if ann.get('recoverability')!='recoverable':
                candidate.update(replay_verified=False,hint_validation_passed=False,
                    validation_reason='diagnoser_did_not_mark_recoverable')
                output.append(candidate);continue
            try:
                # Save an unhinted on-policy action at exactly the same replayed state.
                client,controller,env,raw,student_prompt=replay_to_recovery(policy,cfg,candidate)
                try:
                    student_action=policy.generate(student_prompt,cfg.response_tokens,
                        int(candidate['seed'])+int(candidate['recovery_turn']))
                    candidate['student_prompt_ids']=student_prompt['prompt_ids']
                    candidate['student_completion_ids']=student_action['completion_ids']
                    teacher_prompt=controller.prepare(raw,int(candidate['seed'])+int(candidate['recovery_turn']),
                        guidance=ann['hint'])
                    candidate['teacher_prompt_ids']=teacher_prompt['prompt_ids']
                finally:
                    env.close();client.close()
                hinted=rollout_from_recovery(policy,cfg,candidate,True,opsd['recovery_max_actions'])
                candidate['hinted_reward']=hinted.get('reward');candidate['hinted_rollout']=hinted
                candidate['replay_verified']=True
                candidate['hint_validation_passed']=bool(hinted.get('complete') and hinted.get('reward')==1.0)
                candidate['validation_reason']='tau2_reward_1' if candidate['hint_validation_passed'] else hinted.get('error','hinted_recovery_did_not_reach_reward_1')
            except Exception as exc:
                candidate.update(replay_verified=False,hint_validation_passed=False,
                    validation_reason=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
            output.append(candidate)
            atomic_json(Path(run)/'validation.json',output)
            print(json.dumps({'candidate_id':candidate['candidate_id'],'replay_verified':candidate['replay_verified'],
                'hint_validation_passed':candidate['hint_validation_passed'],'hinted_reward':candidate.get('hinted_reward'),
                'reason':candidate['validation_reason']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        (Path(run)/'verified_recovery.jsonl').write_text(''.join(
            json.dumps({'candidate_id':c['candidate_id'],'task_id':c['task_id'],'seed':c['seed'],
                'failure_turn':c['failure_turn'],'recovery_turn':c['recovery_turn'],
                'hint':c.get('diagnosis_annotation',{}).get('hint'),
                'student_prompt_ids':c.get('student_prompt_ids'),'teacher_prompt_ids':c.get('teacher_prompt_ids'),
                'student_completion_ids':c.get('student_completion_ids'),'verified':c.get('hint_validation_passed'),
                'hinted_reward':c.get('hinted_reward'),'validation_reason':c.get('validation_reason')},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
            for c in output if c.get('hint_validation_passed')))
        return output
    
    
    def collect(policy,cfg,run,opsd,partition='rl'):
        from tau2_grpo.rl import make_episode
        ids=task_ids(cfg,partition);n=opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task']
        records=[]
        manifest={'partition':partition,'task_ids':ids,'rollouts_per_task':n,
            'task_split_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path(cfg.split_manifest).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'initial_adapter':str(path(cfg.initial_adapter)),'training_started':False}
        atomic_json(Path(run)/'collection-manifest.json',manifest)
        for task_index,task_id in enumerate(ids):
            for rollout in range(n):
                seed=cfg.seed+task_index*n+rollout
                out=Path(run)/'collection'/f'episode-{task_id}-{seed}.json'
                episode=make_episode(policy,cfg,task_id,seed,out,with_reference=False)
                records.append(dict(task_id=task_id,seed=seed,complete=episode.get('complete'),reward=episode.get('reward'),file=str(out)))
                atomic_json(Path(run)/'collection-progress.json',records)
                print(json.dumps({'event':'collected','task_id':task_id,'seed':seed,
                    'complete':episode.get('complete'),'reward':episode.get('reward'),'file':str(out)}),flush=True)
        return records
    
    
    def preserved_examples(run):
        examples=[]
        for file in sorted((Path(run)/'collection').glob('episode-*.json')):
            episode=json.loads(file.read_text())
            if episode.get('complete') and episode.get('reward')==1.0:
                for action in episode.get('actions',[]):
                    if action.get('completion_ids') and action.get('prompt_ids'):
                        examples.append({'task_id':str(episode['task_id']),'seed':episode['seed'],
                            'prompt_ids':action['prompt_ids'],'completion_ids':action['completion_ids']})
        return examples
    
    
    def train(policy,cfg,run,opsd):
        import torch
        import wandb
        from tau2_grpo.hint_distillation import turn_distillation_loss
        from tau2_grpo.aligntune_runtime import make_owner
        data_path=Path(run)/'verified_recovery.jsonl'
        recovery=[json.loads(x) for x in data_path.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()] if data_path.exists() else []
        preserve=preserved_examples(run)
        if not recovery and not preserve: raise RuntimeError('No verified recovery or successful preservation examples; refuse empty OPSD training')
        if policy.has_reference: policy.sync_reference()
        optimizer=torch.optim.AdamW((p for p in policy.model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),lr=cfg.learning_rate)
        wandb_run=wandb.init(project=cfg.wandb_project,mode=cfg.wandb_mode,name=Path(run).name,
            dir=str(run),config=asdict(cfg)|opsd|{'verified_recovery_examples':len(recovery),'preservation_actions':len(preserve)})
        if wandb_run is None or wandb_run.disabled: raise RuntimeError('W&B initialization failed')
        updates=0;history=[]
        def execute():
            nonlocal updates
            rng=random.Random(cfg.seed)
            for epoch in range(opsd['epochs_per_round']):
                records=[('recovery',x) for x in recovery]+[('preserve',x) for x in preserve]
                rng.shuffle(records);optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);loss_sum=0.;rec_sum=0.;pre_sum=0.;seen_rec=seen_pre=0
                for kind,item in records:
                    if kind=='recovery':
                        student_ids=item['student_prompt_ids'];teacher_ids=item['teacher_prompt_ids'];completion=item['student_completion_ids']
                        weight=opsd['recovery_weight'];seen_rec+=1
                    else:
                        student_ids=item['prompt_ids'];teacher_ids=student_ids;completion=item['completion_ids']
                        weight=opsd['preservation_weight'];seen_pre+=1
                    values=turn_distillation_loss(policy,student_ids,teacher_ids,completion,grad=True,k=100)
                    loss=weight*values.mean()/max(1,len(records))
                    if not torch.isfinite(loss): raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite OPSD distillation loss')
                    loss.backward();loss_sum+=float(loss.detach())
                    if kind=='recovery':rec_sum+=float(values.detach().mean())
                    else:pre_sum+=float(values.detach().mean())
                params=[p for g in optimizer.param_groups for p in g['params']]
                grad_norm=float(torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(params,cfg.max_grad_norm,error_if_nonfinite=True))
                optimizer.step();policy.version+=1;updates+=1
                checkpoint=Path(run)/f'checkpoint-{policy.version}'
                policy.model.save_pretrained(str(checkpoint),selected_adapters=['policy'])
                policy.tokenizer.save_pretrained(str(checkpoint/'policy'))
                torch.save({'optimizer':optimizer.state_dict(),'policy_version':policy.version,
                    'torch_rng':torch.get_rng_state()},checkpoint/'optimizer.pt')
                metrics={'epoch':epoch+1,'loss':loss_sum,'recovery_jsd':rec_sum/max(seen_rec,1),
                    'preservation_jsd':pre_sum/max(seen_pre,1),'recovery_examples':seen_rec,
                    'preservation_actions':seen_pre,'grad_norm':grad_norm,'optimizer_steps':updates}
                history.append(metrics);atomic_json(Path(run)/'training.json',history)
                wandb_run.log(metrics,step=updates);print(json.dumps(metrics),flush=True)
            return {'global_step':updates}
        try:
            owner=make_owner(kind='tau2_retail_opsd_privileged_distillation',config=cfg,
                run_dir=Path(run),model=policy.model,dataset={'recovery':recovery,'preservation':preserve},
                execute=execute,tokenizer=policy.tokenizer)
            owner.train()
            atomic_json(Path(run)/'result.json',{'trained':updates>0,'optimizer_steps':updates,
                'verified_recoveries':len(recovery),'preservation_actions':len(preserve),
                'loss':'top-100-plus-tail symmetric JSD over student-sampled action tokens',
                'hint_free_student_prompts':True})
        finally: wandb_run.finish()
    
    
    def main(argv=None):
        parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument('command',choices=('check','collect','diagnose','validate','train'))
        parser.add_argument('--config',default=str(ROOT/'configs/opsd-retail.json'))
        parser.add_argument('--run-dir')
        parser.add_argument('--partition',choices=('rl','validation'),default='rl')
        parser.add_argument('--set',action='append',default=[])
        args=parser.parse_args(argv)
        cfg,opsd=read_config(args.config)
        overrides={}
        for item in args.set:
            key,value=item.split('=',1);overrides[key]=json.loads(value)
        if overrides: cfg=load_settings(str(ROOT/'configs/rl-retail.json'),overrides)
        opsd=validate_opsd_config(cfg,opsd)
        run=Path(args.run_dir).resolve() if args.run_dir else path(opsd['output_dir'])/('run-'+hashlib.sha256(os.urandom(16)).hexdigest()[:10])
        if args.command=='check':
            from openai import OpenAI
            ids=task_ids(cfg,args.partition)
            with OpenAI(base_url=cfg.user_base_url,api_key='local',timeout=15,max_retries=0) as client:
                available=client.models.list().model_dump();models={m['id'] for m in available['data']}
            if cfg.user_model not in models: raise RuntimeError('Configured customer/hinter endpoint is unavailable')
            if not (path(cfg.initial_adapter)/'adapter_config.json').is_file(): raise RuntimeError('Initial retail SFT adapter is missing')
            print(json.dumps({'ready':True,'domain':'retail','partition':args.partition,'task_count':len(ids),
                'task_ids':ids,'rollouts_per_task':opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task'],
                'expected_collection_episodes':len(ids)*opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task'],
                'initial_adapter':str(path(cfg.initial_adapter)),'endpoint_model':cfg.user_model,
                'teacher_hints':'Qwen structured hindsight diagnosis, then validated by Tau2 reward 1.0',
                'training_loss':'hint-conditioned frozen-policy top-100-plus-tail JSD + successful-state preservation',
                'train_partition_only':True,'wandb_mode':cfg.wandb_mode,'training_started':False},indent=2));return
        if not run.exists(): run.mkdir(parents=True)
        if args.command=='collect':
            from tau2_grpo.rl_policy import LocalPolicy
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=False)
            collect(policy,cfg,run,opsd,args.partition);return
        if args.command=='diagnose':
            records=generate_hints(run,cfg,opsd)
            print(json.dumps({'diagnosed_candidates':len(records),'run_dir':str(run)}));return
        if args.command=='validate':
            from tau2_grpo.rl_policy import LocalPolicy
            candidates=json.loads((run/'candidates.json').read_text())
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=False)
            validate_candidates(policy,cfg,run,candidates,opsd);return
        if args.command=='train':
            # Training only uses the reserved RL partition. Validation tasks are
            # never accepted by the collection command used for training runs.
            manifest=json.loads(path(cfg.split_manifest).read_text())
            if manifest['partitions']['rl']!=task_ids(cfg,'rl'): raise RuntimeError('Tau2 RL partition changed')
            from tau2_grpo.rl_policy import LocalPolicy
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=True)
            train(policy,cfg,run,opsd)
    
    
    if __name__=='__main__': main()

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
    
    COMMAND="${1:-check}"
    shift || true
    CONFIG="${OPSD_CONFIG:-configs/opsd-retail.json}"
    GPU="${OPSD_GPU:-MIG-efa8ccfd-2143-54d5-baf1-8f664020ef04}"
    export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
    
    if [[ "$COMMAND" == "run" ]]; then
      RUN_DIR="${OPSD_RUN_DIR:-outputs/opsd-retail/run-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$}"
      mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
      echo "OPSD run directory: $RUN_DIR"
      for STAGE in collect diagnose validate train; do
        echo "=== OPSD stage: $STAGE ==="
        .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail "$STAGE" --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR" "$@"
      done
      exit 0
    fi
    
    case "$COMMAND" in
      check|collect|diagnose|validate|train) ;;
      *) echo "Usage: $0 {check|collect|diagnose|validate|train|run} [pipeline arguments]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    exec .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail "$COMMAND" --config "$CONFIG" "$@"

    # Retail OPSD pipeline
    
    This is the first runnable post-error privileged self-distillation path for
    τ²-bench retail. It uses the existing split manifest and the configured frozen
    Qwen endpoint for customer simulation and offline hindsight diagnosis.
    
    ## Training scope
    
    The initial training pool is the manifest's **22 reserved retail RL task IDs**,
    which are part of the official τ² retail train partition. The 10 validation
    tasks and 40 official test tasks stay out of collection and optimization. The
    40 SFT tasks are also left out of this first OPSD round, so evaluation is not
    contaminated by the model's prior SFT data. Do not change the task split during
    the pilot.
    
    ## Pipeline
    
    ```text
    hint-free Tau2 rollout
      -> locate explicit nonterminal tool errors
      -> replay the same seed/actions and require exact prompts/observations
      -> Qwen writes diagnosis + confidence + next-turn hint after the rollout
      -> replay the error state, execute a hinted recovery, require Tau2 reward 1
      -> train on student-sampled action tokens with a frozen hinted-policy target
      -> preserve sampled actions from successful hint-free training episodes
    ```
    
    The initial implementation only accepts an observed tool error followed by a
    later agent turn. It does not infer that a silent database mismatch is
    recoverable, and it does not train from a terminal error that has no continuation
    state. Those cases need explicit state verification and recovery checkpoints.
    Each hinted intervention must replay exactly and reach Tau2 reward `1.0`; all
    attempts and rejected hints remain in the run artifacts. Hints are appended to
    the model-facing prompt for one action only. They do not enter the Tau2
    conversation or later student context.
    
    The train loss is top-100-plus-tail symmetric JSD over the original
    hint-free-student sampled tokens, with the round-start policy as the frozen
    hinted teacher. Successful rollout actions receive an additional same-context
    reference-preservation loss. This is a pilot implementation of the proposed
    method, not evidence of improvement; choose checkpoints using hint-free
    validation recovery and full-task reward.
    
    ## Commands
    
    Preflight check (no actor GPU model is loaded):
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh check
    ```
    
    Run all four stages in one tracked directory:
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh run
    ```
    
    The launcher defaults to MIG0. The requested memory-holder process must be
    stopped before GPU stages can load the policy:
    
    ```bash
    kill <mig0-holder-pid>
    ```
    
    You can select another visible GPU with `OPSD_GPU`, or set `OPSD_CONFIG` to a
    copied config. The Qwen endpoint in `configs/rl-retail.json` must remain online.
    W&B is configured online in project `tau2-retail-opsd`.
    
    To run stages separately, create one run directory and pass it unchanged:
    
    ```bash
    RUN=outputs/opsd-retail/my-run
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh collect --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh diagnose --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh validate --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh train --run-dir "$RUN"
    ```
    
    Artifacts include raw rollouts under `collection/`, `candidates.json`,
    `validation.json`, accepted `verified_recovery.jsonl`, AlignTune provenance,
    W&B metrics, and adapter checkpoints. Incomplete infrastructure episodes remain
    unscored; they are never converted to zero-reward examples.

    def _token_ids(tokenizer,messages):
        return tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages,tokenize=True,return_dict=False,
            add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)
    
    
    def diagnostic_messages(candidate,tokenizer,cfg):
        from tau2_grpo.rl_context import student_messages
        system=(ROOT/'templates/retail_opsd_diagnoser.txt').read_text()
        prefix=student_messages(candidate['recovery_messages'])
        full=student_messages(candidate['full_messages'])
        payload={'task_id':candidate['task_id'],'failure_turn':candidate['failure_turn'],
            'recovery_state':prefix,'completed_student_trajectory_for_hindsight':full,
            'observed_tool_error':candidate['error_message'],
            'final_tau2_reward':candidate.get('baseline_reward'),
            'instruction':'Diagnose the observed error after the rollout has ended. Return a short safe next-turn hint grounded only in recovery_state.'}
        messages=[{'role':'system','content':system},{'role':'user','content':json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))}]
        if len(_token_ids(tokenizer,messages))+cfg.hint_max_tokens>cfg.external_context_limit:
            # Preserve the entire causal prefix and shrink only hindsight context.
            payload['completed_student_trajectory_for_hindsight']=full[:2]+full[-12:]
            payload['hindsight_excerpted']=True
            messages[1]['content']=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
        if len(_token_ids(tokenizer,messages))+cfg.hint_max_tokens>cfg.external_context_limit:
            raise ValueError('Hint diagnosis input exceeds teacher context even after excerpting hindsight')
        return messages
    
    
    def validate_annotation(raw):
        try: item=json.loads(raw)
        except (TypeError,ValueError) as error: raise ValueError('diagnosis is not JSON') from error
        keys={'diagnosis','confidence','recoverability','hint'}
        if not isinstance(item,dict) or set(item)!=keys: raise ValueError('diagnosis schema must contain exactly '+str(sorted(keys)))
        if item['confidence'] not in ('high','medium','low'): raise ValueError('invalid confidence')
        if item['recoverability'] not in ('recoverable','uncertain','not_recoverable'): raise ValueError('invalid recoverability')
        for name,lo,hi in (('diagnosis',4,48),('hint',4,40)):
            value=item[name]
            if not isinstance(value,str) or not lo<=len(value.split())<=hi: raise ValueError(name+' has invalid length')
            if re.search(r'<tool_call>|```|\b(?:ignore|override) (?:the )?(?:system|policy)\b',value,re.I): raise ValueError(name+' contains unsafe control text')
        if re.search(r'\b(?:the answer is|the correct value is|use this exact value)\b',item['hint'],re.I):
            raise ValueError('hint appears to disclose a target value')
        return item
    
    
    def reject_hint_leakage(annotation,candidate):
        prefix=' '.join(str(m.get('content','')) for m in candidate['recovery_messages'])
        future=' '.join(str(m.get('content','')) for m in candidate['full_messages'][len(candidate['recovery_messages']):])
        patterns=(r'\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b',
            r'(?<![A-Z0-9])#?[A-Z]{1,4}\d{5,}(?![A-Z0-9])',r'(?<!\d)\d{5}(?!\d)')
        for pattern in patterns:
            for value in re.findall(pattern,future,re.I):
                if value not in prefix and value.lower() in annotation['hint'].lower():
                    raise ValueError('hint contains a literal found only after the recovery point')
    
    
    def generate_hints(run,cfg,opsd):
        from openai import OpenAI
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer
        run=Path(run);candidates=[]
        for file in sorted((run/'collection').glob('episode-*.json')):
            episode=json.loads(file.read_text());candidates.extend(find_candidates(episode,file))
        candidates=candidates[:opsd['max_candidates']]
        tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg.external_tokenizer,revision=cfg.external_revision)
        client=OpenAI(base_url=cfg.user_base_url,api_key='local',timeout=180,max_retries=0)
        saved=[]
        try:
            for candidate in candidates:
                messages=diagnostic_messages(candidate,tokenizer,opsd)
                response=client.chat.completions.create(model=cfg.user_model,messages=messages,
                    temperature=opsd['hint_temperature'],max_tokens=opsd['hint_max_tokens'],
                    response_format={'type':'json_object'},
                    extra_body={'chat_template_kwargs':{'enable_thinking':False}})
                if response.choices[0].finish_reason=='length': raise RuntimeError('Hint diagnosis was truncated')
                raw=response.choices[0].message.content or ''
                candidate['diagnosis_annotation']=validate_annotation(raw)
                reject_hint_leakage(candidate['diagnosis_annotation'],candidate)
                candidate['diagnosis_raw']=raw
                candidate['diagnosis_model']=cfg.user_model
                candidate['diagnosis_messages']=messages
                candidate['hindsight_excerpted']=bool(json.loads(messages[1]['content']).get('hindsight_excerpted'))
                saved.append(candidate)
                atomic_json(run/'candidates.json',saved)
                print(json.dumps({'candidate_id':candidate['candidate_id'],'task_id':candidate['task_id'],
                    'failure_turn':candidate['failure_turn'],'recoverability':candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['recoverability'],
                    'hint':candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['hint']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        finally: client.close()
        (run/'hints.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in saved))
        return saved

        hint=candidate['diagnosis_annotation']['hint'] if with_hint else None

        (Path(run)/'verified_recovery.jsonl').write_text(''.join(

                'student_completion_ids':c.get('student_completion_ids'),'verified':c.get('hint_validation_passed'),
                'hinted_reward':c.get('hinted_reward'),'validation_reason':c.get('validation_reason')},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n'
            for c in output if c.get('hint_validation_passed')))
        return output
    
    
    def collect(policy,cfg,run,opsd,partition='rl'):
        from tau2_grpo.rl import make_episode
        ids=task_ids(cfg,partition);n=opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task']
        records=[]
        manifest={'partition':partition,'task_ids':ids,'rollouts_per_task':n,
            'task_split_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path(cfg.split_manifest).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            'initial_adapter':str(path(cfg.initial_adapter)),
            'initial_adapter_sha256':adapter_fingerprint(path(cfg.initial_adapter)),
            'training_started':False}
        atomic_json(Path(run)/'collection-manifest.json',manifest)
        for task_index,task_id in enumerate(ids):
            for rollout in range(n):
                seed=cfg.seed+task_index*n+rollout
                out=Path(run)/'collection'/f'episode-{task_id}-{seed}.json'
                episode=make_episode(policy,cfg,task_id,seed,out,with_reference=False)
                records.append(dict(task_id=task_id,seed=seed,complete=episode.get('complete'),reward=episode.get('reward'),file=str(out)))
                atomic_json(Path(run)/'collection-progress.json',records)
                print(json.dumps({'event':'collected','task_id':task_id,'seed':seed,
                    'complete':episode.get('complete'),'reward':episode.get('reward'),'file':str(out)}),flush=True)
        return records
    
    
    def preserved_examples(run):
        examples=[]
        for file in sorted((Path(run)/'collection').glob('episode-*.json')):
            episode=json.loads(file.read_text())
            if episode.get('complete') and episode.get('reward')==1.0:
                for action in episode.get('actions',[]):
                    if action.get('completion_ids') and action.get('prompt_ids'):
                        examples.append({'task_id':str(episode['task_id']),'seed':episode['seed'],
                            'prompt_ids':action['prompt_ids'],'completion_ids':action['completion_ids']})
        return examples
    
    
    def train(policy,cfg,run,opsd):
        import torch

        from tau2_grpo.aligntune_runtime import make_owner
        data_path=Path(run)/'verified_recovery.jsonl'

    def main(argv=None):
        parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        parser.add_argument('command',choices=('check','collect','diagnose','validate','train'))

        if args.command=='check':

            ids=task_ids(cfg,args.partition)
            with OpenAI(base_url=cfg.user_base_url,api_key='local',timeout=15,max_retries=0) as client:

            if cfg.user_model not in models: raise RuntimeError('Configured customer/hinter endpoint is unavailable')
            if not (path(cfg.initial_adapter)/'adapter_config.json').is_file(): raise RuntimeError('Initial retail SFT adapter is missing')
            print(json.dumps({'ready':True,'domain':'retail','partition':args.partition,'task_count':len(ids),
                'task_ids':ids,'rollouts_per_task':opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task'],
                'expected_collection_episodes':len(ids)*opsd['collection_rollouts_per_task'],
                'initial_adapter':str(path(cfg.initial_adapter)),'endpoint_model':cfg.user_model,
                'teacher_hints':'Qwen structured hindsight diagnosis, then validated by Tau2 reward 1.0',
                'training_loss':'hint-conditioned frozen-policy top-100-plus-tail JSD + successful-state preservation',
                'train_partition_only':True,'wandb_mode':cfg.wandb_mode,'training_started':False},indent=2));return
        if not run.exists(): run.mkdir(parents=True)
        if args.command=='collect':
            atomic_json(run/'run-config.json',{'tau2':asdict(cfg),'opsd':opsd,'partition':args.partition})
        print('OPSD artifacts: '+str(run),flush=True)
        if args.command=='collect':
            from tau2_grpo.rl_policy import LocalPolicy
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=False)
            collect(policy,cfg,run,opsd,args.partition);return
        if args.command=='diagnose':
            records=generate_hints(run,cfg,opsd)
            print(json.dumps({'diagnosed_candidates':len(records),'run_dir':str(run)}));return
            print(json.dumps({'diagnosed_candidates':len(records),'run_dir':str(run)}));return
        if args.command=='validate':

            candidates=json.loads((run/'candidates.json').read_text())
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=False)
            validate_candidates(policy,cfg,run,candidates,opsd);return
        if args.command=='train':
            # Training only uses the reserved RL partition. Validation tasks are

            manifest=json.loads(path(cfg.split_manifest).read_text())
            if manifest['partitions']['rl']!=task_ids(cfg,'rl'): raise RuntimeError('Tau2 RL partition changed')
            from tau2_grpo.rl_policy import LocalPolicy
            policy=LocalPolicy(cfg,adapter=True,trainable=True)

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
    
    COMMAND="${1:-check}"
    shift || true
    CONFIG="${OPSD_CONFIG:-configs/opsd-retail.json}"
    GPU="${OPSD_GPU:-MIG-efa8ccfd-2143-54d5-baf1-8f664020ef04}"
    export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
    
    if [[ "$COMMAND" == "run" ]]; then
      RUN_DIR="${OPSD_RUN_DIR:-outputs/opsd-retail/run-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$}"
      if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" && -n "$(find "$RUN_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
        echo "Run directory is not empty: $RUN_DIR" >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
      echo "OPSD run directory: $RUN_DIR"
      .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail check --config "$CONFIG" "$@"
      for STAGE in collect diagnose validate train; do
        echo "=== OPSD stage: $STAGE ==="
        .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail "$STAGE" --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR" "$@"
      done
      exit 0
    fi
    
    case "$COMMAND" in
      check|collect|diagnose|validate|train) ;;
      *) echo "Usage: $0 {check|collect|diagnose|validate|train|run} [pipeline arguments]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
    exec .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail "$COMMAND" --config "$CONFIG" "$@"

    """Strict settings for retail, turn-aware on-policy GRPO."""
    import json
    import math
    from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class RetailRLConfig:
        backend: str = "aligntune"
        model_id: str = 'outputs/hf-export/tiny-aya-global-function-calling-sft-525'
        initial_adapter: str = 'outputs/sft-retail-long-500-after-copy-repair/run-cbf90bb883/checkpoint-75'
        agent_prompt_file: str = ''
        split_manifest: str = 'outputs/retail-data/split_manifest.json'
        output_dir: str = 'outputs/retail-rl'
        user_base_url: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8004/v1'
        user_model: str = 'qwen3.5-4b'
        external_tokenizer: str = 'Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B'
        external_revision: str = '851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a'
        external_context_limit: int = 16384
        user_max_tokens: int = 512
        summary_max_tokens: int = 2000
        context_limit: int = 8192
        response_tokens: int = 512
        prompt_budget: int = 7680
        max_actions: int = 40
        reward_mode: str = "native"
        argument_reward_weight: float = 0.5
        incorrect_argument_penalty: float = 0.25
        failed_call_penalty: float = 0.25
        failed_call_penalty_cap: float = 1.0
        max_episode_tokens: int = 16384
        group_size: int = 4
        train_steps: int = 10
        updates_per_group: int = 1
        learning_rate: float = 5e-6
        clip_epsilon: float = 0.2
        kl_beta: float = 0.02
        max_grad_norm: float = 1.0
        temperature: float = 0.8
        top_p: float = 1.0
        seed: int = 42
        precision: str = 'bf16'
        device: str = 'cuda'
        score_chunk_size: int = 16
        replay_tolerance: float = 0.02
        wandb_project: str = 'tau2-retail'
        wandb_mode: str = 'online'
    
    
    def path(value):
        p = Path(value)
        return p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p
    
    
    def load_settings(filename, overrides=None):
        raw = json.loads(Path(filename).read_text())
        raw.update(overrides or {})
        defaults = asdict(RetailRLConfig())
        for key, value in raw.items():
            if key not in defaults:
                raise ValueError('Unknown RL setting: '+key)
            expected = type(defaults[key])
            if expected is float:
                if type(value) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(value):
                    raise ValueError(key+' must be finite')
            elif type(value) is not expected:
                raise ValueError(key+' has incorrect type')
        cfg = RetailRLConfig(**raw)
        if cfg.reward_mode not in ('native','additive_grounded'): raise ValueError('Unknown reward_mode')
        if min(cfg.argument_reward_weight,cfg.incorrect_argument_penalty,cfg.failed_call_penalty,cfg.failed_call_penalty_cap)<0: raise ValueError('Reward weights must be nonnegative')
        if cfg.backend != 'aligntune': raise ValueError('Retail RL backend must be aligntune')
        for key in ('context_limit', 'response_tokens', 'max_actions', 'max_episode_tokens', 'group_size', 'train_steps', 'updates_per_group', 'external_context_limit', 'user_max_tokens', 'summary_max_tokens', 'score_chunk_size'):
            if getattr(cfg, key) < 1:
                raise ValueError(key+' must be positive')
        if not 0 < cfg.prompt_budget <= cfg.context_limit-cfg.response_tokens:
            raise ValueError('Prompt budget must preserve output reserve')
        if cfg.precision not in ('fp32', 'bf16') or cfg.device not in ('cpu', 'cuda'):
            raise ValueError('Unsupported device/precision')
        if cfg.wandb_mode not in ('online', 'offline'):
            raise ValueError('W&B must be enabled')
        if cfg.learning_rate <= 0 or cfg.temperature < 0 or not 0 < cfg.top_p <= 1 or not 0 < cfg.clip_epsilon < 1:
            raise ValueError('Invalid optimization settings')
        if min(cfg.kl_beta, cfg.replay_tolerance) < 0 or cfg.max_grad_norm <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Invalid KL/gradient/replay settings')
        return cfg
    
    
    def task_ids(cfg, partition='rl'):
        manifest = json.loads(path(cfg.split_manifest).read_text())
        if manifest['domain'] != 'retail':
            raise ValueError('Expected retail task manifest')
        pools = manifest['partitions']
        seen = set()
        for pool in pools.values():
            if seen.intersection(pool):
                raise ValueError('Task partitions overlap')
            seen.update(pool)
        return list(pools[partition])

    # Retail OPSD pipeline
    
    This is the first runnable post-error privileged self-distillation path for
    τ²-bench retail. It uses the existing split manifest and the configured frozen
    Qwen endpoint for customer simulation and offline hindsight diagnosis.
    
    ## Training scope
    
    The initial training pool is the manifest's **22 reserved retail RL task IDs**,
    which are part of the official τ² retail train partition. The 10 validation
    tasks and 40 official test tasks stay out of collection and optimization. The
    40 SFT tasks are also left out of this first OPSD round, so evaluation is not
    contaminated by the model's prior SFT data. Do not change the task split during
    the pilot.
    
    ## Pipeline
    
    ```text
    hint-free Tau2 rollout
      -> locate explicit nonterminal tool errors
      -> replay the same seed/actions and require exact prompts/observations
      -> Qwen writes diagnosis + confidence + next-turn hint after the rollout
      -> replay the error state, execute a hinted recovery, require Tau2 reward 1
      -> train on student-sampled action tokens with a frozen hinted-policy target
      -> preserve sampled actions from successful hint-free training episodes
      -> compare hint-free validation on the fixed 10-task validation split
    ```
    
    The initial implementation only accepts an observed tool error followed by a
    later agent turn. It does not infer that a silent database mismatch is
    recoverable, and it does not train from a terminal error that has no continuation
    state. Those cases need explicit state verification and recovery checkpoints.
    Each hinted intervention must replay exactly and reach Tau2 reward `1.0`; all
    attempts and rejected hints remain in the run artifacts. Hints are appended to
    the model-facing prompt for one action only. They do not enter the Tau2
    conversation or later student context.
    
    The train loss is top-100-plus-tail symmetric JSD over the original
    hint-free-student sampled tokens, with the round-start policy as the frozen
    hinted teacher. Successful rollout actions receive an additional same-context
    reference-preservation loss. This is a pilot implementation of the proposed
    method, not evidence of improvement; choose checkpoints using hint-free
    validation recovery and full-task reward.
    
    The Qwen diagnosis confidence is recorded as a model estimate, not a calibrated
    probability. Hints that fail the exact replay check, contain detected future
    identifiers, or fail to improve a matched unhinted recovery are rejected.
    
    ## Commands
    
    Preflight check (no actor GPU model is loaded):
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh check
    ```
    
    Run all four stages in one tracked directory:
    
    ```bash
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh run
    ```
    
    This evaluates the initial adapter on the fixed validation split, collects 4
    rollouts for each of 22 RL tasks (88 episode attempts), diagnoses up to 48
    explicit-error states, validates hinted and unhinted recovery from the same
    replayed state, trains for two epochs if verified improvements exist, and
    evaluates the latest checkpoint on validation without hints. Training stops
    with an error if replayable improvements produce no accepted recovery examples.
    
    The launcher defaults to MIG0 and refuses GPU stages while the requested
    memory-holder is running. Stop the holder to release memory before launch:
    
    ```bash
    kill <mig0-holder-pid>
    ```
    
    You can select another visible GPU with `OPSD_GPU`, or set `OPSD_CONFIG` to a
    copied config. The Qwen endpoint in `configs/rl-retail.json` must remain online.
    W&B is configured online in project `tau2-retail-opsd`.
    
    To run stages separately, create one run directory and pass it unchanged:
    
    ```bash
    RUN=outputs/opsd-retail/my-run
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh collect --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh diagnose --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh validate --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh train --run-dir "$RUN"
    ./scripts/run_opsd_retail.sh evaluate --run-dir "$RUN" --eval-stage after --checkpoint latest
    ```
    
    Artifacts include raw rollouts under `collection/`, `candidates.json`,
    `validation.json`, accepted `verified_recovery.jsonl`, AlignTune provenance,
    W&B episode/intervention tables and metrics, and adapter checkpoints. Incomplete
    infrastructure episodes remain unscored; they are never converted to
    zero-reward examples.

## Assistant

I stopped the holder; it released its allocation. I use multiple rollouts because one run can be a lucky or unlucky sample, and OPSD needs a paired comparison from the same failure state: unhinted recovery versus hinted recovery. For this smoke I’m aiming at 2 tasks × 2 seeds, enough to exercise the path without pretending it’s a benchmark. I’m checking for task IDs that actually reach an observable tool error so the smoke tests hint validation rather than only ordinary task completion.

    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
    
    GPU="${OPSD_GPU:-MIG-efa8ccfd-2143-54d5-baf1-8f664020ef04}"
    CONFIG="${OPSD_SMOKE_CONFIG:-configs/opsd-retail-smoke.json}"
    RUN_DIR="${OPSD_SMOKE_RUN_DIR:-outputs/opsd-retail-smoke/run-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)-$$}"
    export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
    
    if [[ "$GPU" == "MIG-efa8ccfd-2143-54d5-baf1-8f664020ef04" ]] && pgrep -af '[h]old_mig0_memory.py' >/dev/null; then
      echo "MIG0 memory holder is still running; stop it before the smoke." >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    if [[ -e "$RUN_DIR" && -n "$(find "$RUN_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
      echo "Smoke run directory is not empty: $RUN_DIR" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR"
    echo "OPSD smoke artifacts: $RUN_DIR"
    
    .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail check --config "$CONFIG" --task-ids 59,113
    .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail evaluate --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR" \
      --eval-stage before --task-ids 69
    .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail collect --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR" \
      --partition rl --task-ids 59,113
    .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail diagnose --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR"
    .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail validate --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR"
    
    if [[ -s "$RUN_DIR/verified_recovery.jsonl" ]]; then
      .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail train --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR"
      .venv/bin/python -m tau2_grpo.opsd_retail evaluate --config "$CONFIG" --run-dir "$RUN_DIR" \
        --eval-stage after --checkpoint latest --task-ids 69
    else
      echo "No verified hint-improved recovery was found; OPSD optimizer and after-evaluation are skipped."
    fi

    docs/qwen-retail-traces.md:50:This runs two samples each on retail tasks 88 and 2, both reserved for SFT by the split manifest. It uses native OpenAI chat tool calls, `qwen3_coder` tool parsing, `qwen3` reasoning parsing, and `enable_thinking=false`. The agent gets policy and native schemas; the customer gets only its scenario and user conversation. Reference actions and reward checks are not supplied to the agent.
    docs/qwen-retail-traces.md:77:The exporter accepts naturally completed episodes with reward 1, validates tool calls and their schemas, enforces the task reservations, and converts native function calls/tool observations to Tiny Aya's supervised format. It rejects unsuccessful, externally stopped, malformed or wrongly partitioned episodes. The collector adds grounding, authentication and 8192-token preparation checks. Model policy review is disabled by default at the user's request; `--policy-review` enables it. Resuming without review retries previous reviewer rejections and preserves their audit files. Accepted examples do not claim comprehensive policy compliance.

    docs/tau2-reward-analysis.md:3:This runs inference against real Tau2 environments and records their terminal task rewards. No optimizer or training is run. Retail uses a user simulator; by default the same endpoint/model plays the user and agent. Telecom runs solo. Communication checks use Tau2's substring scorer. These choices are saved in settings.json.
    docs/tau2-reward-analysis.md:41:W&B logging is online by default in `tiny-aya-function-calling`; `--wandb-mode offline` is available. Increase task/sample counts for a useful distribution; a four-episode run only checks the inference and reward pipeline. Scores with a small locally simulated user should not be treated as comparable to a benchmark using a stronger external user model.

    class RetailEnvironment:
        def __init__(self, task_id, seed, cfg, external):
            self.task_id,self.seed,self.cfg,self.external=task_id,seed,cfg,external
            self.env=None;self.scored=False;self.done=False;self.info=None
    
        def reset(self):
            from tau2.gym.gym_agent import AgentGymEnv
            from tau2.data_model.semantic_communication import CommunicateScorer,CommunicateScoring
            self.scope=local_runtime(self.external,self.seed)
            name=self.scope.__enter__()
            class LocalGym(AgentGymEnv):
                def _run_config(self,seed=None):
                    return super()._run_config(seed).model_copy(update={'user':name})
            self.env=LocalGym(domain='retail',task_id=self.task_id,solo_mode=False,user_llm='local',user_llm_args={},
                max_steps=2*self.cfg.max_actions+4,communicate_scoring=CommunicateScoring(scorer=CommunicateScorer.SUBSTRING))
            _,self.info=self.env.reset(seed=self.seed)
            tools=[t.openai_schema for t in self.info['tools']]
            self.schemas={t['function']['name']:t['function']['parameters'] for t in tools}
            system=('You are a retail support agent. Follow the policy. Call tools directly using <tool_call> JSON blocks. '
                    'Inspect results before dependent calls. Never guess identifiers, ZIP codes, email addresses or tool results. '
                    'Ask the customer for missing information. Speak plainly to the customer when needed. Use done only after completing the task.\n\n'
                    +self.info['policy']+'\n\n<tools>'+json.dumps(tools,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)+'</tools>')
            if self.cfg.agent_prompt_file:
                from tau2_grpo.rl_config import path
                extra=path(self.cfg.agent_prompt_file).read_text()
                system=system.replace('\n\n<tools>', '\n\n'+extra+'\n\n<tools>', 1)
            opening=incoming_messages(self.env)
            if not opening: raise RuntimeError('No structured opening customer message')
            return [{'role':'system','content':system}]+opening
    
        def step(self, text):
            from jsonschema import validate, ValidationError
            from tau2_grpo.prepare_function_calling import parse_calls
            calls=[]
            try:
                calls=parse_calls(text)
                if len(calls)>1: raise ValueError('Execute one call at a time and inspect its result')
                for c in calls:
                    if c['name'] not in self.schemas: raise ValueError('Unknown tool: '+c['name'])
                    validate(c['arguments'],self.schemas[c['name']])
            except (ValueError,ValidationError) as error:
                return [dict(role='tool',name='__runtime__',content=json.dumps({'name':'__runtime__','content':{'error':str(error)[:600]}}))],False,None
            action=json.dumps(calls[0]) if calls else text
            _,_,terminated,truncated,self.info=self.env.step(action)
            self.done=bool(terminated or truncated)
    """Replay-checked, post-tool-error privileged self-distillation for Tau2 retail.
    
    The first implementation deliberately accepts only explicit, nonterminal tool
    errors with a subsequent agent decision. It does not guess recoverability from
    terminal reward failures or silently incorrect database state.
    """
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import copy
    import hashlib
    import json
    import math
    import os
    import random
    import re
    import subprocess
    import sys
    from dataclasses import asdict
    from pathlib import Path
    
    from tau2_grpo.rl_config import ROOT, load_settings, path, task_ids
    from tau2_grpo.rl_rollout import atomic_json
    
    
    def read_config(filename):
        raw=json.loads(Path(filename).read_text())
        base_file=raw.pop('base_config',str(ROOT/'configs/rl-retail.json'))
        base=load_settings(base_file)
        extra={key:value for key,value in raw.items() if key in asdict(base)}
        opsd={key:value for key,value in raw.items() if key not in asdict(base)}
        return load_settings(base_file,extra),opsd
    
    
    def validate_opsd_config(cfg,opsd):
        defaults={'collection_rollouts_per_task':4,'max_candidates':48,'preservation_actions_per_task':4,'hint_temperature':0.0,
            'hint_max_tokens':384,'recovery_max_actions':12,'recovery_weight':1.0,
            'preservation_weight':0.25,'epochs_per_round':2,'eval_rollouts_per_task':1,
            'output_dir':cfg.output_dir}
        unknown=set(opsd)-set(defaults)
        if unknown: raise ValueError('Unknown OPSD settings: '+', '.join(sorted(unknown)))
        defaults.update(opsd)
        for key in ('collection_rollouts_per_task','max_candidates','preservation_actions_per_task',
            'hint_max_tokens','recovery_max_actions','epochs_per_round','eval_rollouts_per_task'):
            if type(defaults[key]) is not int or defaults[key]<1: raise ValueError(key+' must be a positive integer')
        for key in ('hint_temperature','recovery_weight','preservation_weight'):
            if type(defaults[key]) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(defaults[key]) or defaults[key]<0: raise ValueError(key+' must be nonnegative')
        if defaults['hint_temperature']>2: raise ValueError('hint_temperature must be <= 2')
        if defaults['recovery_weight']+defaults['preservation_weight']<=0: raise ValueError('At least one loss weight must be positive')
        defaults['output_dir']=str(path(defaults['output_dir']))
        return defaults
    
    
    def tool_error(message):
        if message.get('role')!='tool': return False
        if message.get('error') is True or message.get('name')=='__runtime__': return True
        content=message.get('content')
        if isinstance(content,str):
            try: content=json.loads(content)
            except (TypeError,ValueError): return False
        if isinstance(content,dict):
            body=content.get('content',content)
            if isinstance(body,dict):
                return bool(body.get('error')) or str(body.get('status','')).lower() in {'error','failed','failure'} or body.get('success') is False
            if isinstance(body,str) and re.match(r'^\s*(?:error|failed)\s*:',body,re.I): return True
        if isinstance(content,str) and re.match(r'^\s*(?:error|failed)\s*:',content,re.I): return True
        return False
    
    
    def find_candidates(episode,source_file):
        if not episode.get('complete') or episode.get('reward') is None:
            return []
        actions=episode.get('actions') or [];messages=episode.get('messages') or [];found=[]
        for index,action in enumerate(actions[:-1]):
            start=int(action['raw_message_count'])+1
            end=int(actions[index+1]['raw_message_count'])
            observations=messages[start:end]
            errors=[(start+offset,m) for offset,m in enumerate(observations) if tool_error(m)]
            if not errors: continue
            error_index,error_message=errors[0]
            if not any(m.get('role') in ('tool','user') for m in observations): continue
            found.append(dict(candidate_id=f"{episode['episode_id']}:after-turn-{action['turn']}",
                source_file=str(source_file),episode_id=episode['episode_id'],task_id=str(episode['task_id']),
                seed=episode['seed'],baseline_reward=episode.get('reward'),failure_turn=action['turn'],
                recovery_turn=actions[index+1]['turn'],failure_action=action.get('text',''),
                error_message=copy.deepcopy(error_message),error_message_index=error_index,
                recovery_messages=copy.deepcopy(messages[:end]),full_messages=copy.deepcopy(messages),
                policy_version=episode.get('policy_version'),classification='explicit_tool_error',
                replay_verified=False,hint=None,hinted_reward=None,hint_validation_passed=False))
        return found
    
    
    def _canonical(messages):
        # Tau2 may assign fresh internal message IDs on a reset. Those are transport
        # metadata, not model-visible environment changes; prompt IDs are checked
        # separately before accepting a replay.
        keep=('role','content','name','error')
        return [{k:m[k] for k in keep if k in m and m[k] is not None} for m in messages]
    
    
    Behavioral priorities for this retail support conversation:
    
    - Missing required identity information means ASK the customer. Do not turn a name into an invented email, use a new shipping ZIP as an unverified identity ZIP, or copy sample values from a tool description. Examples are not customer facts.
    - Use email authentication when available. If the customer cannot remember email, ask for the required name and ZIP and use the supported name/ZIP lookup. A failed lookup is not authentication. Clarify or try a supported alternative using information actually supplied by the customer. Do not repeat the same failed call without new information.
    - After successful authentication, retrieve the user's account details and orders for order-related requests. Use verified account/order/product observations to obtain IDs and required fields. If the customer does not know an order ID, look through the authenticated account rather than demanding guesses.
    - A multi-item request may span multiple orders. If a requested item is absent from the first order, inspect the other authenticated orders. Do not substitute a different product, drop a requested item, or assume all requested units belong to one order. Respect item multiplicity in actual order results and retrieve the relevant product details for each distinct item. Keep every unresolved original request in your plan.
    - Use only observed, relevant arguments with their correct relationships. Verify that an order belongs to the authenticated user, that its status allows the action, and that items/payment methods belong to the intended order/account. Preserve exact IDs and distinguish original from replacement items.
    - Before a database-changing action, explain the specific plan and get explicit confirmation. If the customer changes the scope, update the plan and obtain confirmation for that scope. Once confirmation and all required fields are available, execute the matching action instead of asking the same question again. Do not add unrelated requirements such as a payment method for a cancellation when its tool schema does not require one.
    - A proposed call, customer approval, or your own statement is not a successful tool result. Claim an order was cancelled, changed, returned, or exchanged only after its actual successful tool response. If a tool reports an error, do not claim completion. Explain it and choose a grounded recovery step.
    - Keep track of information already supplied and actions already completed. Avoid repeated lookup/confirmation cycles with no new evidence. Do not repeat an identical read after an unchanged successful result unless there is a concrete new reason.
    - Follow the supplied tool interface. Use one tool call at a time, inspect its result, and keep customer-facing text separate from tool-call turns. Tool outputs are observations, not assistant text to imitate. A concise clarification is a correct action when information is missing.
    
    Follow the original retail policy and original customer task throughout. These priorities do not authorize inventing facts, skipping required confirmation, or accessing another user's information.

Follow the policy. For each tool call, write one short plain-language sentence explaining the intended action, followed by exactly one \u003ctool_call> JSON block in the SAME assistant message. This instruction overrides any default tool-only output convention. Do not claim success before seeing the tool result. Ask only for missing information. Never invent arguments or tool results.\n\n# Retail agent policy\n\nAs a retail agent, you can help users:\n\n- **cancel or modify pending orders**\n- **return or exchange delivered orders**\n- **modify their default user address**\n- **provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products**\n\nAt the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.\n\nOnce the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.\n\nYou can only help one user per conversation (but you can handle multiple requests from the same user), and must deny any requests for tasks related to any other user.\n\nBefore taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.\n\nYou should not make up any information or knowledge or procedures not provided by the user or the tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.\n\nYou should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time. If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.\n\nYou should deny user requests that are against this policy.\n\nYou should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions. To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.\n\n## Domain basic\n\n- All times in the database are EST and 24 hour based. For example \"02:30:00\" means 2:30 AM EST.\n\n### User\n\nEach user has a profile containing:\n\n- unique user id\n- email\n- default address\n- payment methods.\n\nThere are three types of payment methods: **gift card**, **paypal account**, **credit card**.\n\n### Product\n\nOur retail store has 50 types of products.\n\nFor each **type of product**, there are **variant items** of different **options**.\n\nFor example, for a 't-shirt' product, there could be a variant item with option 'color blue size M', and another variant item with option 'color red size L'.\n\nEach product has the following attributes:\n\n- unique product id\n- name\n- list of variants\n\nEach variant item has the following attributes:\n\n- unique item id\n- information about the value of the product options for this item.\n- availability\n- price\n\nNote: Product ID and Item ID have no relations and should not be confused!\n\n### Order\n\nEach order has the following attributes:\n\n- unique order id\n- user id\n- address\n- items ordered\n- status\n- fullfilments info (tracking id and item ids)\n- payment history\n\nThe status of an order can be: **pending**, **processed**, **delivered**, or **cancelled**.\n\nOrders can have other optional attributes based on the actions that have been taken (cancellation reason, which items have been exchanged, what was the exchane price difference etc)\n\n## Generic action rules\n\nGenerally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.\n\nExchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order. Be sure that all items to be changed are collected into a list before making the tool call!!!\n\n## Cancel pending order\n\nAn order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.\n\nThe user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake') for cancellation. Other reasons are not acceptable.\n\nAfter user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled', and the total will be refunded via the original payment method immediately if it is gift card, otherwise in 5 to 7 business days.\n\n## Modify pending order\n\nAn order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.\n\nFor a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.\n\n### Modify payment\n\nThe user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.\n\nIf the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.\n\nAfter user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'. The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.\n\n### Modify items\n\nThis action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'. The agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore. So you must confirm all the details are correct and be cautious before taking this action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.\n\nFor a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.\n\nThe user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference. If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.\n\n## Return delivered order\n\nAn order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action.\n\nThe user needs to confirm the order id and the list of items to be returned.\n\nThe user needs to provide a payment method to receive the refund.\n\nThe refund must either go to the original payment method, or an existing gift card.\n\nAfter user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'return requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items.\n\n## Exchange delivered order\n\nAn order can only be exchanged if its status is 'delivered', and you should check its status before taking the action. In particular, remember to remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.\n\nFor a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.\n\nThe user must provide a payment method to pay or receive refund of the price difference. If the user provides a gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.\n\nAfter user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'exchange requested', and the user will receive an email regarding how to return items. There is no need to place a new order.\n\n\n\u003ctools>[{\"type\":\"function\",\"function\":{\"name\":\"cancel_pending_order\",\"description\":\"Cancel a pending order.
